newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Siam City Bank rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Siam City Bank rated buy.

text.p: Seamico Research said on Friday it rated small-sized Siam City Bank a buy due to an expected recovery of its loan growth in 1997 and 1998.

Seamico said in a research report that Siam City Bank's loans are expected to grow 15 percent this year compared to the previous forecast of 18.7 percent due to a slower economy. However, loans are expected to grow at 15.3 percent in 1997 and 17 percent in 1998 due to an expected recovery in the economy.

The bank's net profit is expected to be 3.3 billion baht ($132 million) in 1996 and it would grow to 3.6 billion baht in 1997, Seamico said. Earnings per share are expected to grow 4.7 percent this year and 8.7 percent in 1997, Seamico said.
Seamico said the bank's non-performing loans have risen to around five percent of total loans, slightly higher than 4.5 percent at the end of 1995.
At 0830 GMT, Siam City Bank shares were trading at 29.75 baht, down 0.50 baht.
